devdoc.details: Caution: This is a proxy implementation. Follow proxy pattern best practices

returns._0: Uint representing the INV token balance of the escrow including the additional INV accrued from xINV

claimDBR().details: Requires the caller to be the beneficiary

claimDBRTo(address).details: Requires the caller to be the beneficiary or an allowed claimer

params.to: The address to which the claimed tokens will be sent

params.delegatee: The address to be delegated voting power

initialize(address,address).details: Must be called right after proxy is created.

params._beneficiary: The beneficiary who may delegate token voting power
params._token: The IERC20 token representing the INV governance token

onDeposit().details: This function should remain callable by anyone to handle direct inbound transfers.

params.amount: The amount of ERC20 token to be transferred.
params.recipient: The address to receive payment from the escrow

setClaimer(address,bool).details: Requires the caller to be the beneficiary

params.allowed: A boolean value to determine if the claimer is allowed or not
params.claimer: The address of the claimer to set or unset

devdoc.title: INV Escrow

balance().notice: Get the token balance of the escrow

claimDBR().notice: Allows the beneficiary to claim DBR tokens

claimDBRTo(address).notice: Allows the beneficiary or allowed claimers to claim DBR tokens on behalf of another address

claimable().notice: Returns the amount of claimable DBR tokens for the contract

delegate(address).notice: Delegates voting power of the underlying xINV.

onDeposit().notice: Function called by market on deposit. Will deposit INV into xINV

pay(address,uint256).notice: Transfers the associated ERC20 token to a recipient.

setClaimer(address,bool).notice: Sets or unsets an address as an allowed claimer

userdoc.notice: Collateral is stored in unique escrow contracts for every user and every market. This escrow allows user to deposit INV collateral directly into the xINV contract, earning APY and allowing them to delegate votes on behalf of the xINV collateral
